chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Abū Ayyūb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Regarding a man who married a woman upon her determination or upon his determination, then he died or she died before consummating the marriage, he عليه السلام said: “She has the mut'ah gift and inheritance, but there is no mahr for her.”

He عليه السلام said: “And if he divorces her after having married her upon her determination, her determination must not exceed more than five hundred dirhams, the dowries of the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.الْمُتْعَةُ: the consolatory gift due in this marital circumstance
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثُ: legal inheritance established by the marriage
key_terms.حُكْمِهَا: her determination regarding the mahr amount
key_terms.حُكْمِهِ: his determination regarding the mahr amount
key_terms.خَمْسِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: five hundred dirhams, the upper limit stated here
key_terms.مَهْرَ: the specified dowry due to the wife
key_terms.مُهُورِ نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ: the dowries of the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as the benchmark

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on mahr, inheritance, and mut'ah when a marriage is contracted without a fixed dowry and death or divorce occurs before consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a marriage contracted with the mahr left to the determination of one of the spouses. If death occurs before consummation, the woman receives the mut'ah gift and inheritance, but no fixed mahr. If divorce occurs in a case where the amount was left to her determination, it may not exceed five hundred dirhams, corresponding to the dowries of the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4449 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), regarding a man who married a woman based on her terms or his terms, and then he or she died before consummation.
Imam (as) said: "She is entitled to a gift (mut'ah) and inheritance, but there is no dowry for her."

Imam (as) also said: "If he divorced her after marrying her based on her terms, the amount of her terms cannot exceed five hundred dirhams, the dowry of the wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)."
